Adapted: fine-grained reactivity (signals, memos, effects, no virtual DOM) is Solid's model (Ryan Carniato, https://www.solidjs.com), after S.js (Adam Haile).
Prior art: two-way binding by running the view backwards is close to lenses (Foster, Greenwald, Moore, Pierce and Schmitt, "Combinators for bidirectional tree transformations", TOPLAS 2007).
Prior art: the page is written with the html module, each tag a function as in Elm's Html module (Evan Czaplicki).
Our own: the converter, bound by solving the view instead of writing both directions.
